the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: reduce to affine X = Spec(B); write A as the directed colimit of finite products of k, whose spectra T_i are finite discrete sets with transition maps; by the limits-topology lemma |T| = lim T_i; then the displayed chain computes |T x_k X| = |Spec(colim A_i (x) B)| = lim |Spec(A_i (x) B)| = lim (T_i x |X|) = (lim T_i) x |X| = |T| x |X|, using that filtered colimits commute with tensor products and limits commute with limits (source lines 1275-1300)
